name: Software structure
description: Structural norms generated for this workspace. Every obligation names a path detected in it.

obligationTemplates.title: No runtime dependency cycle among source modules
obligationTemplates.repair: Remove a value dependency along the reported cycle. Use a type-only import where only types are needed.

obligationTemplates.title: Every module import resolves within the declared source graph
obligationTemplates.repair: Fix or remove imports that do not resolve to a collected file — path aliases, bare package specifiers written as relative paths, and escapes from the detected root all leave a hole in the graph every other rule reads.

obligationTemplates.title: Execution does not depend on the CLI
obligationTemplates.repair: Inject the runtime implementation from the composition entry.

obligationTemplates.title: Domain packages do not depend on the shell
obligationTemplates.repair: Accept the required behavior through the domain interface and supply it from the shell.

obligationTemplates.title: No module declares more function-like names than the responsibility ceiling allows
obligationTemplates.repair: Extract one responsibility from the module to satisfy its accepted ceiling.
